# ZAC Forge

> A senior-led, AI-native technology studio. ZAC advises on where technology creates leverage,
> builds the systems that follow, and partners as ongoing senior capability, without agency
> overhead.

ZAC pairs senior technology judgment with AI-native execution. The team is small and senior by
design: one point of contact, with development, design, and strategy behind it, plus trusted
specialists brought in when a project calls for more depth.

## Services

- [Advise](https://zacforge.com/#services): Technology strategy, AI opportunity assessment, product and platform direction, workflow analysis, architecture and technical planning.
- [Build](https://zacforge.com/#services): Custom software, web applications, high-performance websites, internal tools, workflow automation, AI integrations and agents, prototypes and MVPs.
- [Partner](https://zacforge.com/#services): Fractional technology leadership, ongoing product development, technical problem solving, specialist team assembly, existing platform improvement.

## About

- [How ZAC works](https://zacforge.com/#approach): One senior point of contact, with specialists brought in around the problem rather than an agency org chart.
- [Track record](https://zacforge.com/#about): Experience spanning enterprise systems, digital products, web and applications, AI and automation, technology strategy, and design.
